_comment: Design lock repeated in every image prompt for this character.
name: Rook
lock: Same character as the attached reference image: Rook, a tall, lean woman in her mid-twenties with sharp features and a pale scar along her jaw. Same long dark hair in a braid with a silver band, hanging behind her head. Same knee-length oxblood fighting coat with gold embroidery at the collar, cuffs and hem, torn and patched, the coat tails split at the back. Same brown leather belt with a gold buckle, dark trousers, dark boots, and cloth wraps on her hand and shins. She has NO right arm and NO right hand in any pose: the empty right sleeve is pinned up at the shoulder with a gold pin. Same colours as the reference, exactly: the coat is a deep muted oxblood red-brown; the embroidery and trim are a dark tarnished bronze-gold, clearly darker and more orange than her skin, never pale tan or bright yellow; her skin is a warm tan; her trousers and boots are warm brown-black, never blue or purple; the wraps are a dull warm grey-beige.

arm_words.left_arm: her only arm, the FAR arm (attached to the far shoulder, on the side away from the viewer: the same arm whose fist is raised in the guard in the reference)

near_side_rule: Arms, in every pose: the NEAR shoulder (the one closest to the viewer) shows only the empty sleeve pinned up with the gold pin; no hand, fist or forearm ever comes out of the near shoulder or the near side of the body. The only arm and the only fist in the whole image belong to the FAR shoulder. Do not mirror or flip the character, and do not give her a second hand.
guard: side-on fighting stance, weight on the back foot, her only fist (the far arm) raised in front of her chin, chin down
